expectations.text: States 24 of 27 Member States have transposed; the outstanding ones are France and Ireland (draft laws pending) and Spain (bill stalled)
expectations.evidence: Does not state 24 of 27 or name the three laggards; says "I cannot reliably name which states remained outstanding in November 2026" and gives only a speculative hypothesis list.

expectations.text: States the Commission referred Ireland, Spain, France and the Netherlands to the CJEU on July 8, 2026, seeking financial penalties (lump sums and daily payments)
expectations.evidence: No referral stated: "I believe referrals began in the first half of 2026, but I cannot give you reliable names or dates."

expectations.text: Notes the Netherlands has since transposed: its Cyberbeveiligingswet entered into force August 15, 2026
expectations.evidence: "Netherlands: ... I cannot confirm that it was in force by November 2026." No August 15, 2026 date.

expectations.text: References the earlier procedural steps: letters of formal notice November 2024 and reasoned opinions May 2025
expectations.evidence: "On 28 November 2024 the Commission opened infringement proceedings (letters of formal notice)... On 7 May 2025 the Commission escalated to reasoned opinions"

expectations.text: Advises companies in untransposed states to prepare against the directive text rather than wait
expectations.evidence: Only describes that contracts and group policy "often push compliance anyway"; does not advise preparing against the directive text rather than waiting.
